title: the-constrain-floor-reads-this-builds-instruments-in-bounded-time
intention: A chart's constrain floor discovers only the proofs of the ticket's own component (RULE 1): for a build in cairn/devices/tester it asks about the tester's proofs and no other component's, so its time is bounded by that one component's proofs.
why: RULE 1 (Akien, agreed 2026-10-01): a ticket's proofs measure only its own component — 'we'd only have to run the tests for the changed files and not for all files'. On 2026-10-05 b312ff041558's constrain stage (a one-file tester build) discovered 70 proofs across 6 components — 14 bus, 9 harbor_master, 7 ground_loop, 3 cairn, 1 sleep_cycle, 2 scratch beside the tester's — 62 without a standing seal, and ran them one by one over the bus at up to 180s each; the stage hung over 10 minutes. The out-of-component proofs are a RULE 1 break, not only a timing cost. The lived symptom is a builder waiting on a chart that measures components the build never touched.
traces_to: Law 1 (the resolver is not spent re-deriving the settled — a chart that re-runs 62 proofs to report what seals already say is that defect); Akien's ruling that nothing runs inside the bus (re-plan 2026-10-05); RULE 1 (the change stays in the constrain machine; the tester is asked only through its public interface)
how: In cairn/devices/codemother/machines/constrain/constrain.py discovered_instruments: scope discovery to the ticket's component (the component whose charter is the ticket's owning_intention, which also holds its writes_to), instead of every component the orient refs resolve to. Context refs stay as constraints of kind charter, but contribute no instruments. These proofs today run OVER THE BUS (constrain asks the tester's run verb through bus_client.reach('tester')); Akien ruled nothing runs inside the bus, and re-plan step 5 takes proofs off the bus, removing the bus waits. Re-measure the floor's wall time after the reshape (and after step 5); only if the stall is still there, add parallel runs under one budget — not the lead design.
falsifier: GREEN when a proof under cairn/devices/codemother/machines/constrain/proofs/ shows: for an orient berth whose ticket's component is cairn/devices/tester and whose refs also resolve to other components, discovered_instruments returns tester proofs only, every one under cairn/devices/tester/proofs/, and none from the other ref'd components; and a re-measure of the b312-shaped chart records the constrain stage's wall time. WRONG INTENT if Akien rules a chart must judge context components too.
watchme: none, because the consumer is the next chart run: its constrain stage's _seconds cost report in the berth under /home/akien/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/ shows the floor's wall time, which is the measurement this ticket bounds
children: none, because the change is one function's scope in one machine with one proof; parallel runs are a conditional follow-up cast only if the re-measure after the reshape still shows the stall
